anchor: if let path = sampledPath(shape: index, at: frame) { out.path = path }
replacement: if let path = sampledPath(shape: index, at: frame) { out.path = path.elements.isEmpty ? path : shape.outline }

SVG export writes the static stroke width instead of the sampled one

anchor: if let color = sampledColor(.fill(shape: index), at: frame) { out.fill = .solid(color) }
replacement: if case .solid = shape.fill, let color = sampledColor(.fill(shape: index), at: frame) { out.fill = .solid(color) }

note: SVG stroke ignores its sampled colour
